```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```
```{r}
tp_density <- read_csv(here("raw data", "plants_field", "TP_density_SMR26.csv"))
tp_height <- read_csv(here("raw data", "plants_field", "TP_height_SMR26.csv"))
```
```{r}
tp_height <- tp_height |> 
  mutate(
    mean_height_D0 = rowMeans(across(c(height_1_D0, 
                                       height_2_D0, 
                                       height_3_D0)), 
                              na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_height_D46 = rowMeans(across(c(height_1_D46, 
                                        height_2_D46, 
                                        height_3_D46)),
                               na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_height_D365 = rowMeans(across(c(height_1_D365, 
                                         height_2_D365, 
                                         height_3_D365)),
                                na.rm = TRUE),
    percent_height_increase_D46 = ((mean_height_D46-mean_height_D0)/mean_height_D0)*100)

HeightIncrease46_summary_df <- tp_height |> 
  group_by(source, outplant)  |> 
  summarise(
    mean_increase_D46 = mean(percent_height_increase_D46, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_increase_D46 = sd(percent_height_increase_D46, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

HeightMean46_summary_df <- tp_height |> 
  group_by(source, outplant)  |> 
  summarise(
    avg_height_D46 = mean(mean_height_D46, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_height_D46 = sd(mean_height_D46, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

HeightIncrease46_summary_df <- HeightIncrease46_summary_df |>
  mutate(
    source = recode(source,
                    "VC11_00"   = "Coastal",
                    "VC11_01"   = "Estuarine"),
    outplant = recode(outplant,
                    "VC11_00"   = "Coastal",
                    "VC11_01"   = "Estuarine",
                    "hist" = "Restoration site"))

HeightMean46_summary_df <- HeightMean46_summary_df |>
  mutate(
    source = recode(source,
                    "VC11_00"   = "Coastal",
                    "VC11_01"   = "Estuarine"),
    outplant = recode(outplant,
                    "VC11_00"   = "Coastal",
                    "VC11_01"   = "Estuarine",
                    "hist" = "Restoration site"))
```
```{r}
meanheightD46_model <- lm(mean_height_D46 ~ source * outplant, data = tp_height)
anova(meanheightD46_model)

HeightIncrease46_model <- lm(percent_height_increase_D46 ~ source * outplant, data = tp_height)
anova(HeightIncrease46_model)
```

```{r}
HeightIncrease46plot <- ggplot(HeightIncrease46_summary_df, aes(x = outplant, y = mean_increase_D46, color = source, group = source)) +
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(width = 0.1), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.1), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_increase_D46 - se_increase_D46, ymax = mean_increase_D46 +
          se_increase_D46),
    width = 0.1,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.1)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = expression(Delta* " Canopy Height (%)"),
    color = "Source"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Coastal" = "#009999",
      "Estuarine" = "#ff3300"))+
  theme_classic()+
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 0, vjust = 1.3, 
           label ="   Source, p = 0.49\n   Outplant, p = 0.014\n   Source:Outplant, p = 0.35",
           size = 3, lineheight = 0.9)
HeightIncrease46plot
```
```{r}
HeightMean46plot <- ggplot(HeightMean46_summary_df, aes(x = outplant, y = avg_height_D46, color = source, group = source)) +
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(width = 0.1), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.1), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = avg_height_D46 - se_height_D46, 
        ymax = avg_height_D46 + se_height_D46),
    width = 0.1,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.1)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Canopy height (cm)",
    color = "Source"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Coastal" = "#009999",
      "Estuarine" = "#ff3300"))+
  theme_classic()+
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 0, vjust = 1.3, 
           label ="   Source, p < 0.01\n   Outplant, p < 0.01\n   Source:Outplant, p = 0.12",
           size = 3, lineheight = 0.9)
HeightMean46plot
```
```{r}
tp_density_long <-
  tp_density |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("density"),
    names_to = "day",
    values_to = "density"
  )

tp_density_long$day <- as.numeric(gsub("\\D", "", tp_density_long$day))

tp_density_long$treatment <- interaction(
  tp_density_long$source,
  tp_density_long$outplant,
  sep = " - "
)

tp_density_long$day <- factor(
  tp_density_long$day,
  levels = c(0,17,46,365)
)

density_summary_df <-
  tp_density_long |> 
  group_by(source, outplant, treatment, day) |> 
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(density)),
    mean = mean(density, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(density, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd/sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

DEN46_summary_df <- tp_density |> 
  group_by(source, outplant)  |> 
  summarise(
    mean_density_D46 = mean(density_D46, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_density_D46 = sd(density_D46, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

DEN46_summary_df <- DEN46_summary_df |>
  mutate(
    source = recode(source,
                    "VC11_00"   = "Coastal",
                    "VC11_01"   = "Estuarine"),
    outplant = recode(outplant,
                    "VC11_00"   = "Coastal",
                    "VC11_01"   = "Estuarine",
                    "hist" = "Restoration site"))
```
```{r}
D46_model <- lm(density_D46 ~ source * outplant, data = tp_density)
anova(D46_model)
```
```{r}
DEN46plot <- ggplot(DEN46_summary_df, aes(x = outplant, y = mean_density_D46, color = source, group = source)) +
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(width = 0.1), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.1), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_density_D46 - se_density_D46, ymax = mean_density_D46 +
          se_density_D46),
    width = 0.1,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.1)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "No. Shoots",
    color = "Source"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Coastal" = "#009999",
      "Estuarine" = "#ff3300"))+
  theme_classic()+
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 0, vjust = 1.3, 
           label ="                                       Source, p = 0.08\n                                       Outplant, p = 0.07\n                                       Source:Outplant, p = 0.33",
           size = 3, lineheight = 0.9)
DEN46plot
```
